face_design.reason: The angular rocky body supports an angular jaw, narrow horizontal eyes and straight brows. Unlike Roggenrola, medium facial width, average eye spacing, smaller nose and mouth distinguish her as a separate adult. Crystals are chest and head ornaments.
face_design.final_face_line: FACE (her own structure, not the style's default face): angular face, balanced length, medium width; angular defined jaw; narrow eyes, medium size, level outer corners, average spacing; straight medium brows; balanced nose; small mouth.
face_design.observed: Her broader lower face and longer eyes contrast with Roggenrola’s narrow triangular contour and closer sharper eyes; recent three anchors have different soft/elongated contours.
